title: UFO records 1965 - 311003081
doc_notes: This document is an Air Defense Command memorandum summarizing multiple UFO reports from the Exeter, New Hampshire area on September 3, 1965.

incidents.summary: An unidentified woman reported being chased by an unidentified object near Exeter, New Hampshire.
incidents.quote: an unidentified woman reported to Exeter police she was "chased" by an unidentified object

incidents.summary: Police officer Eugene Bertrand witnessed a bright hovering object with flashing red lights.
incidents.quote: witnessed a bright hovering object, from a 1/4 mile distance, that hovered very close above a house

incidents.summary: Norman J. Muscarello reported a silent object with flashing red lights that forced him to dodge to the ground.
incidents.quote: Object reportedly featured flashing and "zig-zagging" red lights without noise

incidents.summary: Patrolmen David Hunt and Eugene Bertrand observed a bright, silent object that moved away at high speed.
behavior: moved away at extremely fast speed
incidents.quote: Both patrolmen were said to have simultaneously observed the UFOB for about 15 to 20 seconds
